headline: Astegon ore mount
title: Astegon | Flying Mount That Gives More Ore | Palworld Guide
video_script: Mining by hand is slow in Palworld one point zero. Astegon is a Dragon and Dark Pal you can ride as a flying mount, and its partner skill, Black Ankylosaur, raises damage to ores by eleven hundred to thirty three hundred percent and gives one hundred fifty to three hundred percent more ore. It works Mining level seven. Will you ride Astegon? Comment below!
description: Astegon in Palworld 1.0 is a Dragon and Dark flying mount with Mining level seven and a big ore bonus.
